name: Yoruba (Advanced Language Study)
description: Certificate of Advanced Language Study in Yoruba offered by the Department of African Studies. A certificate adviser, typically the DUS, advises students on the certification process and certifies completion before the end of eight terms of study. The certificate is listed on the student's transcript once certified.
notes: Letter grade B or above required in all courses
Must complete requirements before the end of eight terms of study
Declare candidacy on Yale Hub as early as possible, no later than January 15 or September 15 of final semester
With adviser approval, one advanced non-L5 Yale course conducted in Yoruba (e.g., independent study graded pass/fail, graduate seminar, or advanced seminar) may count
One LxC course taught in English may count if it includes a weekly discussion section conducted entirely in Yoruba (minimum three students; course designated LxC)
Up to two study-abroad credits taught in Yoruba may be substituted with adviser approval

requirements.name: Courses beyond L4
requirements.description: Four courses beyond the L4 level in Yoruba. At least two must be Yale courses designated L5.
